svg.text: One slice of Compare drawn three times: slots, tiles, By character, a distribution, the shared clock. Change text is today’s red and green unless a strip says otherwise.
WITH THE PROPOSED RED AND GREEN
Bands part by 0.105 (0.094 deutan). Red on band A 4.60, on band B 4.78.
B is 0.10 from the red, 0.09 from SAM, 0.06 from COR and NIN; it reads as a red.
To a deuteranope B is 0.07 from the proposed red. A is 0.04 from BLU.
RECOMMENDED: THE BASELINE IN INK, THE COMPARED RUN IN ONE HUE
WITH THE PROPOSED RED AND GREEN
Bands part by 0.084 (0.080 deutan), by lightness first. Red on band A 5.63, on B 4.57.
B is 0.31 from the red, 0.37 from SAM, 0.36 from the accent: no run is a warm colour.
Cost: blue moves from A to B; as solids the pair is 0.16 apart (0.32 now); B is 0.06 from BLU.
RUNNER-UP: BLUE AND A TRUE ORANGE
WITH THE PROPOSED RED AND GREEN
Bands part by 0.102 (0.099 deutan). Red on band A 4.60, on band B 4.52.
The charting default, and B no longer reads as red: 0.09 from it, 0.10 from the accent.
Cost: B is SAM’s own colour (0.04); a B half row is a SAM row of the live tables.
